Your listing says you "also do all types of demolition." Icon Homes pulled 12 of the 88 wrecking permits Minneapolis issued in the last 12 months. I made you a page with every company that pulled one, the jobs each still has open, and how far they are from Hopkins: https://demolition-notice.vercel.app/for/5735d7d6/

Free, nothing to sign up for.
Aidan

Saw your post: "Free scrap metal. Few hundred pounds in lakeville." 15 apartment and commercial buildings in Minneapolis have open wrecking permits right now. Made you a list, nearest to Lakeville first, with what's likely inside each: https://demolition-notice.vercel.app/for/798faff6/

Free, nothing to sign up for.
Aidan

Your listing says you pick up "scrap metal, wire, computers, some electronics". 10 office, shop and industrial buildings in Minneapolis have open wrecking permits right now. I left off restaurants and apartments, since that's mostly appliances. Here they are, nearest to Shakopee first: https://demolition-notice.vercel.app/for/978feaee/

Free, nothing to sign up for.
Aidan

Free, nothing to sign up for.
Aidan
